incident-bot: [ALERT] SEV3 - embed-service returning elevated 429s for dedicated-us-west. Paging eng-oncall. Check /alerts/7893 and runbook: small-model-fallback.
Priya Shah: grabbing signal now. seeing 429 spikes ~15:06 UTC, p95 latency up to 1.8s, error rate ~8% for that cluster. looks correlated with a single customer traffic surge (customer: AcmeCorp).
Ken Nguyen: confirmed. metrics dashboard -> embeddings/dedicated-us-west shows a steady increase in requests at 15:01 UTC. autoscaler not kicking as expected.
Samir Patel: oncall here. can we throttle or route AcmeCorp to a fallback model? we should avoid customer-facing 429s.
Elena Ruiz: adding temporary quota override for AcmeCorp to avoid 429s while we mitigate. will do a quick request limit bump.
Jorge Alvarez: note: KV-cache eviction logs show spike in evictions around same time. maybe cache pressure causing backend overload.
Priya Shah: timeline so far: 15:00 traffic ramp; 15:04 first 429; 15:08 page. current mitigation plan: 1) enable small-model fallback for AcmeCorp 2) bump per-customer quota 3) scale up pod replica count and increase node pool by 1 GPU node 4) investigate KV-cache retention bug.
Ken Nguyen: executing scale command now: ``kubectl -n embed svc/embeddings-deployment scale --replicas=10`` -> submitted, watching.
ops-bot: Autoscaler target increased to 10 replicas (requested by Ken Nguyen). Node group scaling in progress.
Elena Ruiz: quota bump done: AcmeCorp rate from 400rps -> 800rps for 30m.
Samir Patel: routing fallback applied: AcmeCorp -> embeddings-v1-small (quantized). Expect slight quality delta but prevents errors.
Priya Shah: results: within 3m 429s dropped to ~0.5%, p95 latency dropped to 1.2s. customer reports reduced errors via support channel.
Jorge Alvarez: leaving logs here for context:
```
2026-03-15T15:03:54Z evict kvcache shard-12 size=512MB free=32MB
2026-03-15T15:04:01Z request 10.0.0.45 POST /v1/embeddings -> 429 rate-limit
2026-03-15T15:05:32Z background compaction started
```
Priya Shah: short-term mitigation successful. next steps: schedule postmortem, action items list, and owner assignments.
Ken Nguyen: agree. propose a 48-hour postmortem meeting to capture root cause and remediation. suggested time: 2026-03-17 16:00 UTC (48h).
Samir Patel: placing postmortem draft in #incidents and assigning owners: Priya -> incident lead; Jorge -> cache investigation; Ken -> autoscaler/scale logic; Elena -> customer comms and quota controls.
Priya Shah: action items (short):
- A1: reproduce KV-cache eviction scenario and write test (owner: Jorge, due: 2026-03-22)
- A2: autoscaler thresholds audit and fix (owner: Ken, due: 2026-03-21)
- A3: evolve per-customer soft-fallback policy to auto-trigger on sustained 5% 429s (owner: Samir, due: 2026-03-28)
- A4: support playbook update & customer notification template (owner: Elena, due: 2026-03-19)
Priya Shah: I've created a tracking ticket: INF-4521 with the above items. I'll link findings to the postmortem.
Ken Nguyen: note for postmortem: include simulation results for traffic spikes and autoscaler behavior matrix (seq len, batch size, model variant).
Jorge Alvarez: I'll instrument the cache metrics (evictions, hit-rate by shard) and add a dashboard tile.
Samir Patel: also recommend a game-day exercise for kv-cache thrash scenarios next quarter.
Elena Ruiz: propose a brown-bag session to share prevention patterns and autoscaler gotchas: title suggestion "Preventing cache thrash and graceful fallback patterns". Target audience: eng-runtime, eng-infra, SRE.
Priya Shah: brown-bag logistics: 45 min + 15 min Q&A. Proposed date: 2026-03-25 18:00 UTC. I'll send calendar invite if that works for people.
Ken Nguyen: +1. please also include a short pre-read and a couple of short demos (dashboard, runbook).
Samir Patel: will prepare a short demo of the fallback wiring and a checklist for on-call.
Elena Ruiz: adding training invite to Learning channel and Ops handbook update task.
Priya Shah: closing the loop for this thread: incident contained, mitigations applied, customer impact reduced, postmortem scheduled, action items created. tagging owners in INF-4521. we should follow up in the postmortem with timelines. thanks all. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident 7893 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Postmortem scheduled (1851391367).
